thread:
jordan: Heads-up: I opened a tiny docs thread about aligning terminology for the migration guide and a few broken links I found while updating SDK examples. Link: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/842. Need quick decisions on: naming normalization (short vs canonical), where to put migration snippets, and a redirection plan for old glossary slugs. Can we triage?

sam: On it. Quick thought: keep the canonical glossary term as the descriptive one (e.g., \"Redwood Private (VPC/private deploy)\") but allow a 'display' shortName field for UX. That way the migration guide can reference canonical ids for redirects.

nina: Agree. For migration docs we should include two copy-paste snippets: one for the pre-1.0 SDK (legacy) and one for the new public SDK surface. Many customers search for the old function names. If we include both, search will catch them.

leo: Found three broken internal links while doing the pass: /docs/dedicated -> should point to /docs/deployments/dedicated, /glossary/private -> /glossary/redwood-private. I can push a fix commit but want naming consensus first so redirects don't flip-flop.

jordan: Good catch. Let's decide on slug patterns: use kebab-case, and canonical glossary slugs should be the long descriptive phrase but shortened (e.g., redwood-private). Short display names are separate metadata.

sam: For SDK snippets: propose we standardize on language-first examples (Python, JS) and keep the model identifiers stable in examples. Eg: model: \"rwd-7b-dedicated\" with a parenthetical comment: (# dedicated deployment). For migration examples show mapping table: old param -> new param.

nina: I'll draft the migration table. Example mapping we need: `client.create_session` in legacy -> `client.sessions.create` in new SDK. Also need to flag renamed enums (e.g., `capacity_type` -> `deployment_tier`).

leo: Drafted a short JS example for the migration doc, please eyeball naming: 

```javascript
import Redwood from "@redwood/sdk";
const redwood = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });

// New SDK: sessions.create
const session = await redwood.sessions.create({
  model: "rwd-7b-dedicated", // model = Dedicated deployment
  role: "assistant"
});
```

sam: Looks good. Suggest a one-line comment above about retries/backoff for Dedicated endpoints similar to our retry page. Also add a short troubleshooting blurb: \"If you see HTTP 429/503, try the retry policy or switch to a fallback model.\"

nina: For the glossary redirect plan: I'd like an alias array (strings) in each glossary entry and a small redirect index page that maps legacy slugs to canonical slugs. That keeps redirects predictable and search-friendly.

jordan: Perfect. Action items: 1) leo will fix the three broken links and add redirect stubs for the old slugs, 2) nina will add the migration table and the legacy->new SDK examples, 3) sam will add a one-line retry/troubleshooting callout into the snippets, 4) I'll add the alias array to each glossary entry and create the redirect index. I'll tag in PR #842 for review.

docs-bot: CI check: docs lint OK, linkcheck reported 3 broken links (see leo's note).

leo: Pushed link fixes and the redirect index with placeholder mappings. Left TODO comments where canonical slugs need confirmation.

nina: Added migration table draft and legacy snippet for search indexing. Also added a short note about voice: use \"direct, helpful\" voice in migration guides; avoid vague marketing adjectives. Example: \"Migrate your code\" not \"Upgrade effortlessly\".

sam: Agree on voice. One last nit: in examples prefer `redwood_client` for long-running demos so it reads clearly in docs, but in quickstart use `client` to reduce characters. Might add both variants in separate sections.

jordan: Nice compromise. I'll update the PR description with these decisions and assign reviewers. Aim to merge early tomorrow. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
